features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — A beta of fixes to leases and successions. The ancillary charges statement now says who paid what even after a change of tenant and on a unit split between full ownership and usufruct. The sentences of the «What will change» panel on the end and the start of a lease say who the tenant's items go to, and where the administrator decides. Selling the fully owned half of a split unit now settles the days without a tenant too. After the death of the bare owner, the heirs become full owners by share, as beta.44 promised.

CHANGED: A SUCCESSION STOPS IF THE DECEASED STILL APPEARS AS USUFRUCTUARY OF THE UNIT — On the day of death, on the unit or on a ticked appurtenance. Usufruct ends with death (art. 979 of the Italian Civil Code) and does not pass to the heirs: the message says to register «Usufruct → termination» first, with the same date, then the succession. Since beta.44, on a split unit (full owner of one half and usufructuary of the other), registering the succession of the full half first, with the arrears to the heirs, counted twice the usufruct days after the death: in the tested case the heir paid € 302.47 too much and the deceased was left with an equal credit.

CHANGED: AFTER THE DEATH OF THE BARE OWNER THE HEIRS BECOME FULL OWNERS BY SHARE — When one of two usufructs ends, if before the succession the bare ownership was a single one, the part of the usufruct that ends returns full to the heirs, each for their share, with no choice to make, and the panel says so: this is what beta.44 promised. With usufructs entered by hand, instead, the form asked for a choice: with heirs at 60 % and 40 % it refused every choice, with heirs at 50 % it offered one, and choosing a single heir gave that heir the whole settlement. With two bare ownerships of different origins the choice stays with the administrator.

CHANGED: THE ANCILLARY CHARGES STATEMENT HAS A THIRD MODE — «With the settlement of the change of tenant of …». A change of tenant registered after the instalment plan was generated, with the settlement, gives the incoming tenant their days: the statement left them all to the outgoing tenant, and the incoming one did not appear. Now the incoming tenant has their own item, with the date of the change, and each tenant's total shows, when there is more than one part, the line «of which with the settlement of the change of tenant». With the settlement waived, or cancelled, the statement stays as it was.

CHANGED: THE STATEMENT ON A UNIT SPLIT BETWEEN FULL OWNERSHIP AND USUFRUCT — On days without a tenant the tenant's item goes to whoever enjoys the unit, the full owner and the usufructuary, in two rows: the statement counted those days twice, and a tenant registered after the plan was generated had nothing to reimburse. After the sale of the full half it made the buyer reimburse the usufruct part that stays with the seller too (€ 302.46 to the wrong person in the tested case). When a usufruct with several bare owners ends, the usufructuary's part follows all those who became full owners.

CHANGED: SELLING THE FULL HALF OF A SPLIT UNIT SETTLES THE DAYS WITHOUT A TENANT — When the tenant's item fell on whoever enjoys the unit in more than one stretch of the year, the buyer paid nothing for their days and the seller paid them all, silently, with a panel giving a false reason («the period of the issued instalments ends earlier»). In one of the tested cases the buyer owed € 151.23 and the settlement gave € 0.00.

CHANGED: AT THE END OF A LEASE WITHOUT A NEW TENANT THE SENTENCES NAME WHO RECEIVES THE TENANT'S ITEMS — The panel, the «Instalments» block and the history name who receives them in the allocation (the usufructuary, if there is one, then the owner; on a split unit the full owner together with the usufructuary), not today's owners. Before, the panel named the wrong person on three unit forms out of five, the history wrote a broken sentence, and with a new tenant both said the items «go back» to the owner. The sentence now says it applies to the plans generated or recalculated after the change; on a plan that is no longer recalculated the panel adds, plan by plan, that the instalment shares not yet issued stay with the outgoing tenant and that who pays the days after they leave is up to the administrator.

CHANGED: STARTING A LEASE ON A PLAN THAT IS NO LONGER RECALCULATED NO LONGER PROMISES SHARES TO THE NEW TENANT — This is the limit declared in beta.42. The panel said that from the day of the contract the tenant's items «will be assigned» to the incoming tenant, and the confirmation asked for the tick because «the recipient would change»: the shares instead stay with whoever has them. Now it says, plan by plan and unit by unit, that the plan is no longer recalculated and how the tenant's part is settled: the new tenant reimburses it to whoever pays it, with the ancillary charges statement; in a change of tenant done in two steps it stays in the previous tenant's instalments instead, and who pays the days after they leave is up to the administrator. Only plans with items charged to the tenant and with a period after the start count.

CHANGED: REFUSING THE ACCRUAL WITH SEVERAL BARE OWNERS GIVES THE REAL REASON — It always said the program does not know which usufruct sits on which bare ownership, even where it does (the bare ownership passed to the heirs, or a usufruct born from a reservation registered here) and the part returns full on its own.

CHANGED: AFTER REGISTERING A CHANGE THE SECOND BUTTON IS CALLED «RECORD OF …» — It leads to the record of the incoming person, instead of «Update the condominium register». Underneath, a sentence explains why: the change has already updated who holds the unit and since when, and the condominium register also requires the tax code and the residence or domicile of every holder, tenants included (art. 1130 no. 6 of the Italian Civil Code).

TOUCH-UPS — In the change form the explanation of the share is in the box that opens on the icon next to the label: under the field it made the column longer, and the incoming person's row was no longer aligned. In the printed statement, from the second page on the first line ended up over the header line. The new Italian sentences write «ad Anna».

THE GUIDES — The guide to changes of ownership describes the three modes of the statement, what happens to a lease on a plan that is no longer recalculated and why a succession stops; the «Roles and usufruct» guide says who pays the tenant's item on a split unit on days without a tenant.

NOT YET — Who pays the days after the tenant leaves when their shares are in a plan that is no longer recalculated: the panel says so, the administrator's choice is not built yet. Some fixes to credits in changes of ownership, found together with these, come with the next beta. Unchanged: in a succession after a termination, the sentence «already transferred with a previous change (the usufruct)», while the usufruct has ended; with appurtenances, the final sentence «a plan generated later will divide those items among …» names the same people for every unit; when a lease starts with a co-tenant already on the ticked appurtenance, the panel describes as registrable a change that registration refuses; for 1.10 plans that do not remember their financial year, the settlement and the statement deduce it from the creation date, and the administrator cannot correct it.

FOR DEVELOPERS — No migrations. ProspettoOneriAccessori: the conguaglio mode with conguaglio_del on the item, con_il_conguaglio in the tenant's total; the chain of payers follows the role, per person, and is kept in memory for the calculation; twin rows are merged before being divided; the unit's «già versato» is divided like the settlement. InsiemePeriodi::unione(). PeriodoDellaRiga: to rebuild the days of a fallback row only the rows resolved on the requested role are removed. FrasiObbligati::alPostoDellInquilino(), aChi(), a(); nomiOClausola() removed. NudiDellEstinzione: the inherited bare ownership (per() returns ereditata), A_MANO public. ConguaglioPassaggio::nudiDellEstinzione() public. AnteprimaPassaggioRequest: the succession stop. New tests: ProspettoCambioInquilinoTest, FineLocazioneFrasiTest, InizioLocazionePianoFermoTest, UnitaMistaRipiegoVenditaTest, EstinzioneDopoMorteDelNudoTest, SuccessioneConUsufruttoInCorsoTest.
